Luna warned on Day 1 that Opus had planned to claim officer and name Terra, and the town voted her out that day. Terra claimed officer on Day 2, named Opus as her shown killer, and her card turned out to be real. Gemma then said on Day 3 that she had guarded Terra on Night 3, but Terra was already out on Day 2, so the claim collapsed. Sonnet was killed on Night 3, and on Day 3 the town voted Opus out 3 to 1. Every killer was out, and the town won.
